ycy
Ycy command line interface
Usage:
  ycy [flags]
Commands:
  completion	Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  config	Manage ycy configuration
  diff	Compare two directories in a browser
  export	Export command output
  fs	Browse a directory in a browser
  git	Git utilities
  rm	Remove files/dirs, or smartly clean project artifacts when no path given
  run	Run package.json scripts
  tunnel	Manage trusted tunnel clients and tunnel definitions
  upgrade	Update ycy to the latest release
  zip	Zip a directory into a zip file
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for ycy
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
  -V, --version	Print version
